en.title: Find a Skill for the job in front of you
en.description: Turn a concrete development or document task into a Skill search with a clear selection goal. The prepared request asks the agent to compare original sources, coverage, and tool prerequisites before proposing a candidate to try.
en.inputLabel: What do you need a Skill for?
en.inputHint: Include your stack and the check or deliverable you need.
en.outcome: A shortlist with sources, coverage, prerequisites, and a reason to choose each candidate.

zh.title: 为眼前的任务找到合适的 Skill
zh.description: 将具体开发或文档任务整理成有选择目标的 Skill 搜索。这里的请求会要求 Agent 比较原始来源、覆盖范围和工具前提，再提出适合试用的候选项，而不是直接按名称安装。
zh.inputLabel: 你需要 Skill 帮你做什么？
zh.inputHint: 说明技术栈，以及要完成的检查或交付物。
zh.outcome: 候选清单，列明来源、覆盖范围、使用前提和选择理由。

en.title: Locate the React performance work that matters
en.description: Describe one React route or interaction and the evidence you can provide. Shape a performance-review request around request waterfalls, client code, and rendering, with prioritized findings tied to files and a way to verify the proposed change.
en.inputLabel: Which React route needs attention?
en.inputHint: Name the slow interaction and the files or measurements you can provide.
en.outcome: Prioritized findings tied to files, with evidence and a way to verify each proposed change.

zh.title: 找出值得优先处理的 React 性能问题
zh.description: 围绕一个 React 路由或交互说明现象及已有证据，将请求限定到请求瀑布、客户端代码和渲染问题。预期结果应关联具体文件，并说明拟议修改怎样通过测量核验。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个 React 页面需要检查？
zh.inputHint: 写明卡顿操作，以及能提供的文件或测量结果。
zh.outcome: 按影响排序的问题，关联具体文件、证据及修改后的验证方法。

en.title: Untangle a component API
en.description: Use an existing control and its callers to frame a composition review. The request can focus on boolean props, state ownership, and real layout needs, with migration suggestions checked against the behaviors the current component must preserve.
en.inputLabel: Which component combinations are hard to maintain?
en.inputHint: Include existing props, callers, and the behaviors that must remain.
en.outcome: A proposed component API, migration examples, and checks for the existing behaviors.

zh.title: 理清复杂组件的接口
zh.description: 从已有控件和调用方出发组织组合审阅，将问题限定到布尔属性、状态归属及真实布局需求。请求中的迁移建议需要对照现有行为，说明哪些接口可以收敛、哪些约束必须保留。
zh.inputLabel: 哪些组件组合难以维护？
zh.inputHint: 提供现有属性、调用示例和必须保留的行为。
zh.outcome: 组件接口方案、调用迁移示例，以及原有行为的检查项。

en.title: Investigate a mobile interaction on its target device
en.description: Bring a mobile screen, target device, and troublesome interaction into the task brief. Prepare a request that distinguishes list rendering, gestures, and platform behavior, with proposed changes checked through the same path on representative devices.
en.inputLabel: What happens on the mobile screen?
en.inputHint: Specify Expo or React Native, device class, and the gesture or list that fails.
en.outcome: Likely bottlenecks with affected components and a device-based verification plan.

zh.title: 从目标设备上的交互问题开始
zh.description: 将移动页面、目标设备和异常交互带入任务说明，区分列表渲染、手势和平台行为。请求应围绕同一路径提出修改及设备验证方法，而不是把整个页面交给 Agent 无范围重做。
zh.inputLabel: 移动页面出现了什么问题？
zh.inputHint: 说明 Expo 或 React Native、设备档次及出问题的手势或列表。
zh.outcome: 可能的瓶颈、涉及组件，以及在目标设备上的验证计划。

en.title: Give one navigation a clear visual transition
en.description: Start with the relationship between two interface states and describe what should remain recognizable. The request can compare shared elements, stable item identity, and content reveals while retaining navigation and reduced-motion behavior as review requirements.
en.inputLabel: Which navigation should feel connected?
en.inputHint: Describe the source view, destination, shared elements, and reduced-motion expectations.
en.outcome: A transition proposal that distinguishes navigation from background updates and accounts for reduced motion.

zh.title: 为一次导航设计清楚的视觉过渡
zh.description: 先说明两个界面状态之间的关系，以及哪些元素应保持可辨认。请求可以比较共享元素、稳定条目身份和内容出现方式，同时将导航及减少动态效果行为纳入审阅要求。
zh.inputLabel: 哪一次导航需要连续感？
zh.inputHint: 说明起点、终点、共享元素和减少动态效果的要求。
zh.outcome: 区分导航与后台更新的过渡方案，并包含减少动态效果的处理。

en.title: Review an interface against actionable rules
en.description: Choose a page or interaction that needs a focused interface review. Ask for findings tied to code and observed behavior, distinguishing keyboard access, control semantics, and feedback before deciding which repairs belong in the implementation scope.
en.inputLabel: Which interface should be reviewed?
en.inputHint: Provide files and the interactions to check, such as keyboard input or form errors.
en.outcome: Actionable file-and-line findings, with the affected interaction and expected behavior.

zh.title: 把界面规范落实到具体问题
zh.description: 选择需要重点审阅的页面或交互，要求发现能够对应代码位置和实际行为。请求中区分键盘访问、控件语义与反馈问题，再决定哪些修复需要进入本次实施范围。
zh.inputLabel: 要审查哪个界面？
zh.inputHint: 提供文件与检查重点，例如键盘操作或表单错误。
zh.outcome: 可执行的文件与行号问题，说明受影响的操作及预期行为。

en.title: Make onboarding instructions easier to follow
en.description: Provide the draft, its reader, and the operation the text must explain. Frame a writing review around terminology, prerequisites, and examples, with proposed edits preserving confirmed technical meaning rather than replacing useful detail with a generic style preference.
en.inputLabel: Which instructions need an editorial review?
en.inputHint: Include the document and its reader; identify facts that must stay unchanged.
en.outcome: File-and-line editorial findings that distinguish wording issues from facts needing confirmation.

zh.title: 让入门说明更容易照着完成
zh.description: 提供原稿、目标读者及文字需要说明的操作，将审阅集中到术语、前提和样例。请求中的表达调整需要保留已确认的技术含义，避免用泛化文风偏好替换真正有用的细节。
zh.inputLabel: 哪些说明需要编辑审查？
zh.inputHint: 提供文档和目标读者，标明不可改变的事实。
zh.outcome: 文件与行号编辑意见，分别说明表达问题和仍需确认的事实。

en.title: Prepare a preview for a specific branch
en.description: Describe the branch and project you want reviewed before any deployment proceeds. The prepared task can verify Vercel links and team scope, then propose a preview and its page checks within the authorization you actually provide.
en.inputLabel: What should be previewed?
en.inputHint: Identify the branch, Vercel project and team, and the checks required before publishing.
en.outcome: A confirmed preview plan and verification checklist; deployment proceeds only within the scope you authorize.

zh.title: 为指定分支准备可检查的预览
zh.description: 部署前说明准备审阅的分支与项目，让任务先核对 Vercel 关联和团队范围。请求可以提出预览方案及页面检查，但实际执行仍以你提供的授权为边界，不默认直接面向生产。
zh.inputLabel: 这次要预览什么改动？
zh.inputHint: 写明分支、Vercel 项目和团队，以及发布前必须完成的检查。
zh.outcome: 已核对的预览方案与验证清单，部署仅按你授权的范围执行。

en.title: Scope a Vercel CLI task before using credentials
en.description: Define the intended Vercel operation and refer to an approved credential location without supplying the secret itself. The request should verify project and organization scope, then describe an authenticated invocation and result checks that avoid token disclosure.
en.inputLabel: Which Vercel settings should be inspected?
en.inputHint: Specify project, team, and approved credential location; omit the token value.
en.outcome: A scoped inspection plan that identifies credential references and keeps secret values out of output.

zh.title: 先明确 Vercel CLI 任务范围
zh.description: 说明目标 Vercel 操作，并引用批准的凭据位置而非填写密钥。请求应先确认项目及组织范围，再整理认证调用与结果检查方法，让 token 不出现在任务材料、命令记录或报告中。
zh.inputLabel: 要检查哪些 Vercel 配置？
zh.inputHint: 说明项目、团队与已批准的凭据位置，不填写令牌值。
zh.outcome: 范围明确的检查方案，标明凭据引用，并避免在输出中显示秘密值。

en.title: Explain a change in Vercel usage
en.description: Bring a usage increase, slow route, or cache question with the measurements behind it. Ask for an evidence-based investigation connecting metrics to source and settings, with optimization choices that can be retested and still satisfy content-freshness requirements.
en.inputLabel: Which usage change needs investigation?
en.inputHint: Include the period, affected functions or routes, and available cost or latency data.
en.outcome: Evidence-backed opportunities ranked by likely impact, with a measurement plan for each.

zh.title: 解释 Vercel 用量变化的原因
zh.description: 提供使用量变化、慢路由或缓存疑问及相关测量，让调查沿指标进入代码和设置。请求应比较有依据的优化选择，说明如何复测，并保留内容时效与缓存失效方面的要求。
zh.inputLabel: 哪项用量变化需要调查？
zh.inputHint: 说明时间段、涉及函数或路由，以及已有成本或延迟数据。
zh.outcome: 按可能影响排序的优化机会，每项附证据和效果衡量方法。

en.title: Turn a browser failure into a repeatable check
en.description: Specify the permitted website or application and the interaction to inspect. Prepare a browser task that reads the relevant CLI guidance, observes current targets, and records the actual result, with exploratory or Electron work following its own documented setup.
en.inputLabel: Which browser flow should be checked?
en.inputHint: Provide the test URL, allowed account context, steps, and expected result.
en.outcome: The failing step, observed behavior, and evidence needed to reproduce the issue.

zh.title: 把浏览器故障变成可复现的检查
zh.description: 指定允许操作的网站或应用及待检查交互，让任务先阅读适用 CLI 指引，再观察当前目标并记录实际结果。探索测试和 Electron 场景使用各自配置，不直接沿用普通网页会话假设。
zh.inputLabel: 要检查哪条浏览器流程？
zh.inputHint: 提供测试网址、允许使用的账号上下文、步骤和预期结果。
zh.outcome: 失败步骤、实际行为及复现问题所需的证据。

en.title: Build a page from a deliberate visual direction
en.description: Describe the product, audience, and constraints behind the interface you want. Shape a design request that proposes a coherent direction and checks desktop and mobile results, with existing content and required behavior treated as part of the brief.
en.inputLabel: What page are you designing?
en.inputHint: Describe the audience, primary action, supplied copy, and existing visual identity.
en.outcome: A visual direction followed by an implementation and desktop/mobile review, subject to the available tools.

zh.title: 从明确的视觉方向开始构建页面
zh.description: 说明界面背后的产品、受众和约束，将请求组织为有依据的设计方向及实现检查。桌面、移动效果和已有内容都属于任务背景，必须保留的行为也应在开始前明确。
zh.inputLabel: 这次要设计什么页面？
zh.inputHint: 说明受众、主要操作、已有文案和视觉身份。
zh.outcome: 先给出视觉方向，再按可用工具实现，并检查桌面与手机布局。

en.title: Turn a recurring task into a testable Skill
en.description: Start with a recurring method or an existing Skill that behaves inconsistently. The request can examine real examples, missing instructions, and activation boundaries, producing a reviewable revision and evaluation plan before the guidance is treated as reusable.
en.inputLabel: Which recurring workflow should become a Skill?
en.inputHint: Provide sample inputs, the expected output, and examples of good and poor results.
en.outcome: An instruction draft, clear inputs and outputs, and representative evaluation requests.

zh.title: 把重复任务整理成可验证的 Skill
zh.description: 从周期性方法或表现不稳定的 Skill 出发，让任务检查真实样例、指令缺口与激活边界。预期结果是可审阅的修订和评估方案，而不是仅生成一个文件就认定方法已经能够复用。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个重复流程适合整理成 Skill？
zh.inputHint: 提供输入样例、预期输出，以及好结果和差结果的例子。
zh.outcome: 指令草稿、明确的输入输出，以及有代表性的评估请求。

en.title: Extract a PDF without losing uncertain details
en.description: State whether the PDF task concerns extraction, assembly, or form filling and identify the relevant pages or fields. Prepare a request that preserves source references and uncertainty, with saved-output checks matched to the actual operation instead of file appearance alone.
en.inputLabel: What should be taken from the PDF?
en.inputHint: Identify the pages, table columns, and required output format.
en.outcome: Structured output with page references, preserved labels, and explicit uncertainty markers.

zh.title: 提取 PDF 内容并保留不确定信息
zh.description: 说明 PDF 任务属于提取、组合还是表单填写，并指出相关页码或字段。请求需要保留来源和不确定性，按实际操作检查保存结果，避免只凭文件外观判断处理已经正确。
zh.inputLabel: 需要从 PDF 中提取什么？
zh.inputHint: 写明页码、表格列和目标文件格式。
zh.outcome: 结构化输出，保留标签与页码出处，并明确标记不确定信息。

en.title: Revise a Word report while preserving its structure
en.description: Bring approved text or an existing Word file and define the part that may change. The request can organize document structure and layout checks while preserving unrelated comments, formatting, or template elements required by the original delivery brief.
en.inputLabel: Which Word sections should change?
en.inputHint: Name the sections, source notes, and headings, tables, or comments that must remain.
en.outcome: An edited document with the requested structure preserved and changed pages rendered for review.

zh.title: 修改 Word 报告并保留原有结构
zh.description: 提供已批准文字或已有 Word 文件，明确允许改变的范围。请求可以组织文档结构及版面检查，同时保留无关批注、格式和任务要求继续使用的模板元素，让局部修订有清楚边界。
zh.inputLabel: Word 文档的哪些部分需要修改？
zh.inputHint: 说明章节、参考笔记，以及必须保留的标题、表格或批注。
zh.outcome: 按范围修改的文档，并提供变化页面的渲染结果供检查。

en.title: Update a presentation inside its existing template
en.description: Describe the audience, evidence, and slides needed for the presentation. Prepare a task that connects narrative with the supplied template or assets and reviews rendered pages, so an editable deck is assessed by its actual content and layout.
en.inputLabel: Which slides need new information?
en.inputHint: Provide the deck, approved results, and constraints on charts, order, and branding.
en.outcome: An updated deck with changed slides checked for overflow, missing content, and chart consistency.

zh.title: 在现有模板中更新演示文稿
zh.description: 说明演示的受众、证据和需要的页面，将叙事与已有模板或素材连接起来。请求应包含渲染页审阅，使可编辑文稿依据真实内容和版面验收，而不是仅检查是否已经生成文件。
zh.inputLabel: 哪些幻灯片需要更新？
zh.inputHint: 提供原文件、已确认结果，以及图表、顺序和品牌要求。
zh.outcome: 更新后的文稿，检查修改页面的溢出、内容缺失与图表一致性。

en.title: Create a workbook whose totals can be checked
en.description: Provide the workbook or raw data with column meanings and calculation requirements. The request can bound the target ranges, preserve formulas and source meaning, and define recalculation and sample checks before accepting the saved spreadsheet as correct.
en.inputLabel: How should the spreadsheet summarize the data?
en.inputHint: Specify source columns, grouping dimensions, totals, and treatment of missing values.
en.outcome: A recalculated workbook with traceable source rows, formulas, and documented assumptions.

zh.title: 生成合计结果可核对的工作簿
zh.description: 提供工作簿或原始数据，说明列含义和计算要求。请求中限定目标区域，保留公式及来源含义，并安排重新计算和样本核对，确认保存的电子表格真正符合任务要求。
zh.inputLabel: 电子表格应怎样汇总数据？
zh.inputHint: 写明来源列、分组维度、合计口径及缺失值处理方式。
zh.outcome: 重新计算后的工作簿，保留来源行、公式与假设说明。

en.title: Audit a form before redesigning it
en.description: Choose whether the interface needs an audit, refinement within an approved direction, or stronger edge states. The prepared request keeps that distinction explicit, with product context and representative screen checks guiding changes rather than an open-ended redesign.
en.inputLabel: Where does the interface lose clarity?
en.inputHint: Describe the form, user task, keyboard behavior, and empty or error states.
en.outcome: A focused interface audit with prioritized changes, before any edits are made.

zh.title: 先审查表单，再决定如何改版
zh.description: 先区分界面需要审计、在已定方向内精修，还是补足边界状态。请求保留这个决定，并结合产品背景和代表屏幕检查安排修改，避免将一项具体优化扩大为没有范围的重新设计。
zh.inputLabel: 界面的哪一部分不够清楚？
zh.inputHint: 说明表单、用户任务、键盘行为及空白或错误状态。
zh.outcome: 范围明确、按优先级整理的界面问题，先给发现再进行修改。

en.title: Clarify a domain decision before implementation
en.description: Bring the plan and the choices that would change what gets built. Frame a design interview around the audience, constraints, and unresolved dependencies, then ask for settled decisions and warranted documentation changes before implementation is planned.
en.inputLabel: Which domain rule is still unclear?
en.inputHint: Include current terminology, code references, and the decision you cannot yet make.
en.outcome: Resolved and open questions, plus only the glossary or ADR changes justified by the discussion.

zh.title: 实施前澄清一项领域决定
zh.description: 提供计划，以及会改变构建方向的关键选择，将访谈围绕受众、约束和未决依赖展开。请求应先整理已定决定及必要文档变化，再进入实施规划，不让问题由未经确认的假设填补。
zh.inputLabel: 哪条领域规则还没有说清？
zh.inputHint: 提供当前术语、代码位置和仍无法决定的问题。
zh.outcome: 已澄清与待定问题，并仅提出讨论确实需要的术语表或 ADR 改动。

en.title: Implement one behavior through a failing test
en.description: Define the observable behavior and the public interface through which it can be tested. Prepare a TDD request that connects one failing test with a minimal implementation, keeping unrelated cleanup and private implementation assertions outside that increment.
en.inputLabel: Which behavior should change?
en.inputHint: Give the acceptance rule, current behavior, and the public interface that exposes it.
en.outcome: A sequence of failing tests, minimal implementations, and verification for each accepted behavior.

zh.title: 用失败测试逐项实现行为
zh.description: 明确可以观察的行为和适合测试的公共接口，将请求限定到一条失败测试及其最小实现。无关整理和针对私有细节的断言不混入这个增量，让修改与需要验证的行为对应。
zh.inputLabel: 这次需要改变什么行为？
zh.inputHint: 说明验收规则、当前表现和能够观察行为的公开接口。
zh.outcome: 逐项对应验收行为的失败测试、最小实现与验证结果。

en.title: Choose an architecture improvement worth making
en.description: Name a maintenance hotspot, difficult test boundary, or concept scattered across files. Ask for evidence-backed architectural candidates and their dependency impact, with a design discussion before migration scope is chosen rather than an immediate repository-wide rewrite.
en.inputLabel: Which subsystem is creating friction?
en.inputHint: Name recurring changes, difficult dependencies, and existing architecture decisions.
en.outcome: Candidate improvements with supporting code evidence and tradeoffs, awaiting your selection.

zh.title: 选出值得实施的架构改进
zh.description: 指出维护热点、难以测试的边界或分散在多个文件的概念，要求候选方案具有历史和依赖依据。请求先进入设计讨论再选择迁移范围，避免从一个痛点直接扩大为整个仓库的重写。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个子系统正在造成维护摩擦？
zh.inputHint: 说明反复发生的改动、难处理的依赖和已有架构决定。
zh.outcome: 附代码证据与取舍的候选改进，等你选择后再实施。

en.title: Establish a signal for the bug before fixing it
en.description: Describe expected and actual behavior with the environment and failing input. Shape the investigation around a repeatable signal and competing causes, then require the repair to be checked on the original flow rather than judged by an unrelated successful run.
en.inputLabel: Which failure needs a reliable signal?
en.inputHint: Include a reproduction, expected behavior, observed result, and relevant logs.
en.outcome: A repeatable failure signal, an evidence-based diagnosis, and verification of the original scenario.

zh.title: 修复前先建立能检测故障的信号
zh.description: 提供实际与预期行为、环境和失败输入，让调查围绕可重复信号及不同原因展开。请求中的修复必须回到原流程核对，不能以另一次无关的成功运行代替对最初问题的验证。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个故障需要建立反馈信号？
zh.inputHint: 提供复现方法、预期行为、实际结果和相关日志。
zh.outcome: 可重复的故障信号、有证据的原因判断，以及原始场景的验证。

en.title: Review the implementation against its specification
en.description: Identify a fixed comparison point and the requirements the change must satisfy. Prepare a review request that separates convention from missing behavior, with findings linked to relevant diffs and evidence rather than broad impressions about code quality.
en.inputLabel: Which branch and specification should be compared?
en.inputHint: Name the base branch, requirement file, and changes excluded from review.
en.outcome: Separate standards and specification findings, tied to the relevant changed lines.

zh.title: 对照需求审查实现差异
zh.description: 指定固定比较点和修改需要满足的要求，将审阅请求区分为规范检查与行为缺口。发现应关联相关差异及证据，而不是只给出笼统的代码质量印象，方便随后决定具体修复。
zh.inputLabel: 要比较哪个分支和需求文件？
zh.inputHint: 说明基准分支、需求文档和不在审查范围内的改动。
zh.outcome: 分别报告规范与需求问题，并关联相关修改行。

en.title: Prepare a fresh session to continue the work
en.description: State what the next session is responsible for and which work has already been established. The request can preserve decisions, evidence, and accessible paths in a focused continuation brief, leaving unrelated conversation history outside the handoff.
en.inputLabel: What work is being handed over?
en.inputHint: Identify the feature, specification, current diff, decisions, and remaining checks.
en.outcome: A concise handoff with evidence links, current state, unresolved decisions, and the next verification steps.

zh.title: 让新会话接得上当前工作
zh.description: 说明下一会话负责什么，以及当前已经确定哪些工作。请求可将决定、证据和可访问路径整理成聚焦的续接简报，排除无关对话历史，让接手者能够理解真实状态并继续推进。
zh.inputLabel: 需要交接哪项工作？
zh.inputHint: 说明特性、需求、当前差异、已有决定和剩余检查。
zh.outcome: 简洁交接材料，包含证据入口、当前状态、未决事项与下一步验证。

en.title: Compare approaches before committing to a design
en.description: Bring the current project, intended outcome, and decisions that remain open. Prepare a design discussion that compares alternatives and preserves real constraints before drafting the agreed direction, with implementation planning following rather than replacing that conversation.
en.inputLabel: What workflow needs a design?
en.inputHint: Describe the user, current process, desired outcome, and constraints.
en.outcome: Clarified requirements and compared approaches, followed by a design only after the direction is agreed.

zh.title: 确定设计前先比较可行方向
zh.description: 提供项目现状、预期结果和仍待确认的决定，将请求组织成比较方案的设计讨论。先保留真实约束并确认方向，再形成设计和后续实施规划，不用直接开工代替必要沟通。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个工作流需要设计？
zh.inputHint: 说明用户、现有流程、期望结果及约束。
zh.outcome: 澄清后的需求与方案比较，方向确认后再形成设计。

en.title: Trace a failure across the system boundary
en.description: Supply the full failure and a nearby working case before asking for a fix. The request can trace component boundaries and test one causal hypothesis, with the original symptom rerun after repair instead of adding another unsupported patch.
en.inputLabel: Where does the failure appear and disappear?
en.inputHint: Compare working and failing environments, pipeline stages, and observed error output.
en.outcome: A root-cause investigation with tested hypotheses and a rerun of the original failing job.

zh.title: 沿系统边界追查故障原因
zh.description: 修复前提供完整故障和相近成功样例，让请求沿组件边界检查证据并验证一个因果假设。修复后重新运行原始症状，避免在已有失败尝试之上继续添加缺乏支持的补丁。
zh.inputLabel: 故障在哪个环境出现或消失？
zh.inputHint: 比较正常与失败环境、流水线阶段及实际错误输出。
zh.outcome: 包含假设验证的根因调查，并重新运行原来失败的任务。

en.title: Define an evidence-based repository audit
en.description: Define the authorized revision and audit boundaries before investigating repository security. Prepare a request that preserves coverage gaps, source traces, and independent validation status, so candidate vulnerabilities remain distinguishable from findings supported by adequate evidence.
en.inputLabel: What is inside the authorized audit scope?
en.inputHint: Identify the repository, revision, excluded paths, and available isolation.
en.outcome: Coverage and evidence reports with unresolved leads marked needs_validation and remaining gaps made explicit.

zh.title: 为仓库审计明确证据与范围
zh.description: 调查仓库安全前，明确授权版本和审计边界。请求需要保留覆盖缺口、源码链路及独立核验状态，使候选漏洞与已有充分证据的发现能够区分，不把合理怀疑直接报告为事实。
zh.inputLabel: 授权审计的范围是什么？
zh.inputHint: 说明仓库、版本、排除路径及可用的隔离条件。
zh.outcome: 覆盖与证据报告，未解决线索标记 needs_validation，并列明剩余缺口。

en.title: Turn product screenshots into a short demo
en.description: Bring product assets, a video project, or the variants you need and define the delivery format. The request can organize scene changes and preview checks, with frame evidence and exported files reviewed before the video is accepted for delivery.
en.inputLabel: What should the demo show?
en.inputHint: Include screenshots, duration, sequence, brand assets, and export requirements.
en.outcome: A preview and exported demo plan, with optional media services identified before they are used.

zh.title: 把产品截图整理成短视频演示
zh.description: 提供产品素材、已有视频项目或所需版本，说明交付格式。请求可组织场景修改和预览检查，在交付前结合帧证据与实际导出文件核对结果，不以命令运行成功代替视觉验收。
zh.inputLabel: 演示需要展示什么？
zh.inputHint: 提供截图、时长、镜头顺序、品牌素材和导出要求。
zh.outcome: 可审阅的预览与演示导出方案，采用可选媒体服务前先说明条件。

en.title: Design a reviewable coding task loop
en.description: Use one repository change to examine a complete context, tool, and review loop. The prepared request can compare Codex integration surfaces and produce an execution design with evidence and approval points before any installation or tool connection is proposed.
en.inputLabel: Which repository task needs a clearer execution loop?
en.inputHint: Describe the change, test command, review point, and available integration surface.
en.outcome: A task loop with context inputs, tool calls, test evidence, and an explicit approval point.
en.example: Use the Codex repository to help design a documentation-import change in my repository. Map context loading, file edits, tests, and review. Compare CLI and app-server integration before proposing an implementation; do not install or connect anything yet.

zh.title: 为代码任务设计可审阅的执行循环
zh.description: 用一项仓库修改研究完整的上下文、工具和审阅循环。请求可以比较 Codex 集成入口，先形成带证据及批准节点的执行设计，再提出安装或连接工具方案，不预设环境已经具备。
zh.inputLabel: 哪项仓库任务需要明确执行循环？
zh.inputHint: 说明改动、测试命令、审阅节点和现有集成入口。
zh.outcome: 包含上下文输入、工具调用、测试证据与明确审批节点的任务循环。
zh.example: 参考 Codex 仓库，为我的文档导入改动设计执行流程。梳理上下文读取、文件修改、测试与审阅，比较 CLI 和 app-server 集成后再提出实现，暂不安装或连接工具。

en.title: Separate a workflow into replaceable plugins
en.description: Describe the collection, transformation, or external-tool gap in an existing task. Prepare a composition request that assigns plugin responsibilities and checks compatibility, with a small representative run before the proposed Harness workflow becomes a recurring dependency.
en.inputLabel: Which workflow steps should be independently replaceable?
en.inputHint: Describe inputs, processing stages, provider settings, and failure behavior.
en.outcome: A plugin responsibility map and a small validation plan for the first end-to-end run.
en.example: Refer to DeepSeek Harness to split my weekly public-news digest into collection, deduplication, and summary plugins. Define each input and output, provider configuration, and retry behavior. Check the current interfaces before drafting a prototype plan.

zh.title: 把资料流程拆成可替换插件
zh.description: 说明现有任务在采集、转换或外部工具上的缺口，让请求明确插件职责与兼容性。拟议 Harness 组合先经过小型代表任务验证，再考虑作为周期性依赖，避免一次性拼装后直接长期使用。
zh.inputLabel: 哪些步骤需要能够独立替换？
zh.inputHint: 说明输入、处理阶段、模型配置和失败时的行为。
zh.outcome: 插件职责图，以及首次完整运行的小规模验证计划。
zh.example: 参考 DeepSeek Harness，将每周公开资讯简报拆为收集、去重和摘要插件。定义输入输出、模型配置和重试行为，核对当前接口后再拟定原型方案。

en.title: Map an issue request to an authorized coding task
en.description: Start with a permitted repository request and where its result should return. The task can examine DSH's request-to-ticket-to-draft-PR pattern while preserving requester authorization and original scope, with connections and execution permissions checked as separate prerequisites.
en.inputLabel: Which repository requests should become tasks?
en.inputHint: Specify the repository, allowed requesters, labels, review policy, and expected PR output.
en.outcome: A request-to-ticket flow with authorization checks, duplicate handling, and a reviewable handoff.
en.example: Read the DSH Superagent prototype setup and authorization documents. Design a GitHub-issue-to-draft-PR flow for my repository, listing requester permissions, duplicate-event handling, and required approval. Show the plan before any account, webhook, or service configuration.

zh.title: 把 Issue 请求转成有范围的代码任务
zh.description: 从允许处理的仓库请求及结果返回位置出发，研究 DSH 从请求到任务单和草稿 PR 的方式。请求保留发起者授权与原始范围，并将连接和执行权限作为独立前提核对。
zh.inputLabel: 哪些仓库请求应转为任务？
zh.inputHint: 说明仓库、允许的请求者、标签、审阅规则与 PR 交付要求。
zh.outcome: 包含授权检查、重复请求处理与可审阅交接的请求到工单流程。
zh.example: 阅读 DSH Superagent 原型的配置与授权文档，为我的仓库设计 Issue 到草稿 PR 的流程。列明请求者权限、重复事件处理和必要审批，任何账号、Webhook 或服务配置前先给出方案。

en.title: Build a small repository-report loop
en.description: Pick a small task loop or a specific extension gap before adding runtime components. The request can compare clearer instructions with Pi's library responsibilities, then define a representative test that shows whether an executable extension is actually needed.
en.inputLabel: Which repository report should be repeatable?
en.inputHint: Specify the revision range, files to inspect, output format, and permitted tools.
en.outcome: A minimal context/tool/session design and a reproducible sample report for review.
en.example: Use Pi’s toolkit documentation to design a weekly repository-change report. Define how to collect the commit range, inspect diffs, maintain the session, and produce a Markdown summary with file references. Start with a design and sample output, not a new installation.

zh.title: 从一个仓库报告任务搭建小循环
zh.description: 增加运行组件前，先选一项小型任务循环或具体扩展缺口。请求可比较改进指令与 Pi 库职责两种方向，再通过代表性测试判断是否确实需要新增可执行扩展。
zh.inputLabel: 哪种仓库报告需要重复生成？
zh.inputHint: 说明版本范围、检查文件、输出格式和允许使用的工具。
zh.outcome: 最小上下文、工具与会话设计，以及可复现的样例报告。
zh.example: 参考 Pi 工具链文档设计每周仓库变更报告，明确提交范围收集、差异读取、会话延续和带文件引用的 Markdown 汇总。先给设计与样例，不直接开始安装。

en.title: Separate code exploration from implementation
en.description: Describe the repository investigation or code change you want to make reviewable. Use the request to separate discovery, editing, and acceptance, then assess whether OpenCode's task modes or extension surfaces offer a useful pattern for your existing tools.
en.inputLabel: Which change should begin with read-only exploration?
en.inputHint: Provide the feature, repository area, acceptance rules, and tools that may write files.
en.outcome: An exploration brief and an implementation handoff with distinct permissions and acceptance checks.
en.example: Use OpenCode’s plan/build workflow as a reference for adding search to my application. First define a read-only investigation of the data and routes, then a separate implementation phase. List the evidence I should review before allowing edits.

zh.title: 把代码调查与实施分开
zh.description: 说明需要调查或修改的仓库任务，将请求区分为发现、编辑和接受环节。再评估 OpenCode 的任务模式或扩展接口是否适合现有工具，让参考机制服务具体问题，而非默认更换工作环境。
zh.inputLabel: 哪项改动需要先只读调查？
zh.inputHint: 提供特性、仓库范围、验收规则和可以写文件的工具。
zh.outcome: 权限与验收分开的调查简报及实施交接。
zh.example: 参考 OpenCode 的 plan/build 流程，为应用增加搜索功能。先设计数据与路由的只读调查，再定义独立实施阶段，列出允许修改前需要我审阅的证据。

en.title: Decide what a recurring workflow should remember
en.description: Choose a recurring brief, reusable method, or task that needs a later continuation. Prepare a memory-design request that identifies essential context, source freshness, and update ownership before deciding what Hermes-inspired knowledge should persist between sessions.
en.inputLabel: Which knowledge should survive between runs?
en.inputHint: Describe the feedback sources, reusable decisions, retention limits, and review responsibilities.
en.outcome: A memory/Skill boundary, source traceability rules, and a checked weekly-summary format.
en.example: Refer to Hermes Agent to design a weekly customer-feedback review. Separate reusable category definitions from individual customer details, define retention and human review, and show a sample summary with source references before suggesting any integration.

zh.title: 决定重复流程应当记住什么
zh.description: 选择周期性简报、可复用方法或需要稍后续接的任务，让请求明确必要上下文、来源时效和更新责任。再判断哪些 Hermes 式任务知识应跨会话保存，不将全部历史一并当作记忆。
zh.inputLabel: 哪些知识需要跨任务保留？
zh.inputHint: 说明反馈来源、可复用决定、保留期限和审阅职责。
zh.outcome: 记忆与 Skill 的边界、来源追溯规则及每周总结格式。
zh.example: 参考 Hermes Agent 设计每周客户反馈审阅。区分可复用分类与个别客户信息，定义保留期限和人工审阅，先给带来源的总结样例，再考虑集成。

en.title: Plan an editor-to-agent review handoff
en.description: Bring a development task whose roles or editor handoffs are unclear. The request can compare Kimi Code's tool feedback and lifecycle boundaries, defining the context and result each stage needs before proposing an adapter or changing the execution workflow.
en.inputLabel: What should move from the editor into the task?
en.inputHint: Name the editor, selected files, review scope, and required return format.
en.outcome: An interface compatibility check and a handoff format for context, findings, and verification.
en.example: Read Kimi Code’s ACP documentation and assess a review handoff from my editor. I want selected files and acceptance criteria sent as one task, with findings returned against code locations. Verify compatibility first and propose the smallest test.

zh.title: 规划编辑器到 Agent 的审查交接
zh.description: 提供角色分工或编辑器交接不清楚的开发任务，让请求比较 Kimi Code 的工具反馈与生命周期边界。先说明各阶段需要的上下文和结果，再提出适配器或执行流程调整方案。
zh.inputLabel: 需要从编辑器传递哪些内容？
zh.inputHint: 说明编辑器、选中文件、审查范围和返回格式。
zh.outcome: 接口兼容性检查，以及上下文、问题与验证结果的交接格式。
zh.example: 阅读 Kimi Code 的 ACP 文档，评估从我的编辑器发起审查的交接方式。将选中文件与验收标准作为同一任务，按代码位置返回问题；先核对兼容性，再提出最小测试。

en.title: Keep a diagram task connected to its workspace
en.description: Describe a long task whose material, progress, and review decisions need to stay connected. Use ZCode as a reference for interface and execution responsibilities, then ask for a bounded design that makes the proposed outcome understandable before expanding tools or views.
en.inputLabel: Which diagram should accompany the task?
en.inputHint: Describe the diagram format, workspace inputs, allowed edits, and export target.
en.outcome: A plugin interaction sketch with data boundaries and a small compatibility test.
en.example: Study ZCode’s UI Plugin documentation and Excalidraw example. Design a workflow that turns my project notes into an editable process diagram, keeps revisions linked to the source notes, and exports a reviewable result. Check APIs before proposing integration.

zh.title: 让图示任务与工作空间保持关联
zh.description: 说明一项需要连接资料、进展和审阅决定的长任务，以 ZCode 为参考区分界面与执行职责。请求先形成范围明确、结果易于判断的设计，再考虑扩展工具或增加其他界面。
zh.inputLabel: 哪种图示需要随任务协作？
zh.inputHint: 说明图示格式、工作空间输入、允许修改范围和导出目标。
zh.outcome: 包含数据边界的插件交互草图，以及小规模兼容性测试。
zh.example: 研究 ZCode 的 UI Plugin 文档和 Excalidraw 示例，为项目笔记设计可编辑流程图工作流，保留修改与来源笔记的关联并导出可审阅结果。核对 API 后再提出集成方案。

en.title: Apply a consistent review discipline to a change
en.description: Bring an implementation that may duplicate existing code or add unnecessary abstractions. Frame the request around real requirements, caller impact, and existing checks, using Ponytail's guidance to compare a smaller solution without discarding validation or error handling.
en.inputLabel: Which change needs a disciplined review?
en.inputHint: Provide the diff, chosen review depth, and rules that the current agent can actually load.
en.outcome: Prioritized review findings that distinguish required fixes from optional cleanup.
en.example: Read Ponytail’s rules and host-specific installation notes. Help review my import-module diff at a depth appropriate to its risk. Check which instructions are usable in the current environment, report findings first, and do not install hooks or change files without my go-ahead.

zh.title: 为一次改动建立一致的审查要求
zh.description: 提供可能重复现有代码或增加多余抽象的实现，将请求围绕真实需求、调用影响及已有检查展开。借鉴 Ponytail 比较更小方案时，仍保留验证和错误处理，而不以减少代码作为唯一目标。
zh.inputLabel: 哪项改动需要严格审查？
zh.inputHint: 提供差异、期望审查深度，以及当前 Agent 实际能加载的规则。
zh.outcome: 按优先级整理的问题，分别说明必要修复与可选清理。
zh.example: 阅读 Ponytail 的规则与宿主安装说明，按导入模块改动的风险选择审查深度。先核对当前环境能使用的指引，报告问题，未经我同意不安装 hooks 或修改文件。

en.title: Divide a content task into roles with handoffs
en.description: Describe a task that needs separate research, review, or operational roles. The request can use MausBot's team model to define shared material and handoff results, while checking service connections and external-action permissions separately from the portable role instructions.
en.inputLabel: Which deliverable needs several roles?
en.inputHint: Specify source material, role boundaries, handoff artifacts, and who approves publication.
en.outcome: A role and handoff plan with review checkpoints and one sample content package.
en.example: Refer to MausBot’s role and approval model to organize a weekly product newsletter. Define researcher, drafter, and reviewer responsibilities, the files each hands over, and the approval before publication. Give a small sample without creating bots or connecting accounts.

zh.title: 为内容任务安排角色与交接
zh.description: 说明需要研究、审阅或运营角色协作的任务，参考 MausBot 团队方式定义共享资料与交接结果。请求将服务连接和外部行动权限与可移植角色指令分开，不假定分享手册就具备执行条件。
zh.inputLabel: 哪项交付需要多个角色？
zh.inputHint: 说明素材、角色边界、交接文件，以及由谁批准发布。
zh.outcome: 角色与交接方案、审阅节点及一份内容包样例。
zh.example: 参考 MausBot 的角色与审批设计，组织每周产品简报。明确研究、起草和审阅职责、各自交接文件及发布前审批；先给小样，不创建机器人或连接账号。

en.title: Make a desktop step observable and verifiable
en.description: Name the application, intended record, and fields or controls the task may affect. Prepare a desktop-workflow request that observes current targets and checks saved results, with runtime integration, platform permissions, and final approval kept explicit before automation proceeds.
en.inputLabel: Which desktop step repeats in your workflow?
en.inputHint: Name the app, starting state, expected file or result, and permission constraints.
en.outcome: An observe/act/verify sequence, including stop conditions and evidence for each completed step.
en.example: Read Agent Desktop’s installation and snapshot documentation. For my monthly invoice-export task, map the application states, required permissions, snapshot references, and export verification. Start with a dry-run plan; do not grant permissions or operate the application yet.

zh.title: 让桌面步骤可以观察和验证
zh.description: 说明目标应用、记录和允许影响的字段或控件，让桌面任务请求包含当前目标观察及保存结果检查。自动操作前明确运行集成、平台权限和最终批准，不只描述一串点击动作。
zh.inputLabel: 工作流里哪项桌面操作反复出现？
zh.inputHint: 说明应用、起始状态、预期文件或结果，以及权限限制。
zh.outcome: 观察、操作、验证的步骤，包含停止条件和完成证据。
zh.example: 阅读 Agent Desktop 的安装和快照文档，为每月发票导出梳理应用状态、所需权限、快照引用和导出检查。先给演练方案，暂不授予权限或操作应用。

en.title: Prepare a repeatable product-image workflow
en.description: Bring the media brief and the workflow or assets already available. The request can map generation and finishing stages, identify node and model dependencies, and define representative output checks before increasing batches or transferring the production recipe.
en.inputLabel: What image set should the workflow produce?
en.inputHint: Describe inputs, background/style constraints, model availability, hardware, and output size.
en.outcome: A proposed node workflow with required models, input/output mapping, and a small image-validation plan.
en.example: Use ComfyUI’s official workflow documentation to plan consistent backgrounds for ten product photos. I will provide the originals, target size, and available hardware. Identify a suitable graph, required models, and a two-image validation step before installation or batch execution.

zh.title: 准备可重复的商品图片工作流
zh.description: 提供媒体简报和已有工作流或素材，让请求梳理生成与后期阶段、节点及模型依赖。先定义代表输出的检查方式，再扩大批次或迁移制作方案，避免只保留流程图而遗漏复现条件。
zh.inputLabel: 需要生成怎样的一组图片？
zh.inputHint: 说明输入、背景或风格要求、可用模型、硬件与输出尺寸。
zh.outcome: 节点流程方案，列明所需模型、输入输出映射及小批量图片检查计划。
zh.example: 参考 ComfyUI 官方工作流文档，为十张商品照片规划统一背景。我会提供原图、目标尺寸与可用硬件；先确定节点流程、所需模型和两张图片的验证步骤，再考虑安装或批量运行。

en.title: Trace the impact of a change through a code graph
en.description: Identify a feature, refactor boundary, or design claim to investigate in the source. Prepare a Graphify-based reading plan that narrows relevant files and preserves relationship provenance, with final conclusions checked in code rather than accepted from inferred links alone.
en.inputLabel: Which change needs an impact map?
en.inputHint: Identify the repository, entry points, proposed change, and files to exclude.
en.outcome: A dependency path and affected-module report with source checks and explicit graph gaps.
en.example: Refer to Graphify’s official installation and CLI documentation to analyze an authentication-module change. Check whether graphify is available, plan the graph build, and identify callers and affected modules. Validate graph findings in source; propose any setup before executing it.

zh.title: 沿代码图谱追踪改动影响
zh.description: 指出需要调查的功能、重构边界或设计主张，让请求借助 Graphify 缩小源文件阅读范围并保留关系来源。最终结论仍需回到代码核验，不能只依据图中的推断连线接受判断。
zh.inputLabel: 哪项改动需要影响范围图？
zh.inputHint: 说明仓库、入口、计划修改内容和排除文件。
zh.outcome: 依赖路径与受影响模块报告，附源码核对和图谱缺口。
zh.example: 参考 Graphify 官方安装与 CLI 文档，分析认证模块改动。先检查 graphify 是否可用，规划建图并定位调用方和受影响模块；结论需回到源码核对，新增配置先提出方案再执行。

en.title: Plan parallel changes without mixing their worktrees
en.description: Describe repository work that could benefit from separate attempts or independent review. The request can compare Orca-style ownership and worktree boundaries, with a fixed handoff revision, shared checks, and a distinct decision about which results should be integrated.
en.inputLabel: Which feature can be split into parallel changes?
en.inputHint: Describe frontend, backend, and test boundaries, shared files, and merge dependencies.
en.outcome: A worktree/branch plan with task ownership, integration order, and a combined verification checklist.
en.example: Study Orca’s worktree documentation to plan parallel frontend, API, and test work for my search feature. Identify shared-file conflicts, branch ownership, merge order, and end-to-end checks. Show the plan before creating worktrees or launching other agents.

zh.title: 为并行改动安排独立工作树
zh.description: 说明适合独立尝试或单独审阅的仓库工作，让请求比较 Orca 式任务归属与工作区边界。交接版本、共同检查和最终集成决定分别明确，避免将并行完成直接等同于可以合并。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个特性适合拆成并行改动？
zh.inputHint: 说明前端、后端与测试边界、共享文件及合并依赖。
zh.outcome: 工作树与分支方案，明确任务归属、集成顺序和联合验证清单。
zh.example: 阅读 Orca 的 worktree 文档，为搜索特性规划前端、API 与测试的并行工作。识别共享文件冲突、分支归属、合并顺序和完整流程检查；创建工作树或启动其他 Agent 前先展示方案。

en.title: Make one business metric reproducible
en.description: Choose a metric that different teams calculate differently. Use Auto Ontology’s semantic layer as a reference for tying the definition to tables, reviewed SQL and a small evaluation set.
en.inputLabel: Which metric needs an agreed definition?
en.inputHint: Name the metric, candidate tables, reporting period and exclusions.
en.outcome: A metric contract, reference query, and cases for detecting bad joins or missing coverage.
en.example: Read NVIDIA Auto Ontology’s README and MCP documentation. Help me specify monthly net revenue from orders, invoices, and refunds. Return a definition, reference SQL for a sample schema, and five test questions. Flag ambiguous joins and ask before connecting to a live database.

zh.title: 把一个业务指标变成可复算的查询
zh.description: 挑一个团队之间口径不同的指标，参考 Auto Ontology 的语义层，将定义、数据表、审核过的 SQL 和验证题组串起来。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个指标需要先统一口径？
zh.inputHint: 写下指标名称、候选表、统计周期和排除项。
zh.outcome: 一份指标口径、参考查询，以及识别错误连接或覆盖缺口的验证用例。
zh.example: 阅读 NVIDIA Auto Ontology 的 README 和 MCP 文档，帮我明确订单、发票和退款中的月度净收入。输出口径、用于示例结构的参考 SQL 和五道验证题。标出有歧义的连接条件，连接真实数据库前先询问。

en.title: Turn three viewport captures into a prototype brief
en.description: Bring authorized screenshots and a short description of the interaction. Use Craft Anything’s evidence and comparison model to turn what you observed into checks the builder can run.
en.inputLabel: Which screen and interaction should the prototype cover?
en.inputHint: Name the page, supported viewport widths, and key states such as an open menu or error.
en.outcome: A responsive prototype brief with an evidence list, asset boundaries, and a state-by-state test matrix.
en.example: Study Craft Anything’s clean-room and comparison workflow. Use my desktop, tablet and phone screenshots of our pricing page to write a replacement brief. List observable behavior, specify our own assets, and create checks for the open menu and monthly/yearly toggle. Separate assumptions from evidence.

zh.title: 用三种屏宽的截图写一份原型任务书
zh.description: 提供有权使用的界面截图和交互说明，参考 Craft Anything 将观察与对照结合的做法，整理编程 Agent 可以逐项验证的任务。
zh.inputLabel: 原型要覆盖哪个界面和交互？
zh.inputHint: 写下页面、目标屏宽，以及菜单展开、报错等关键状态。
zh.outcome: 一份响应式原型任务书，含证据清单、素材边界和逐状态验收表。
zh.example: 参考 Craft Anything 的洁净室与对照流程，用我们价格页的桌面、平板和手机截图写一份改版任务书。记录可观察行为，指定使用自有素材，为菜单展开和月付／年付切换列出验收项，并区分假设与证据。

en.title: Prepare a timestamped cut list for OpenCut
en.description: Turn a transcript or clip inventory into an editing plan with in and out points and a short playback checklist.
en.inputLabel: Which recording should the edit cover?
en.inputHint: Include source filenames, timestamps, target duration, and intended audience.
en.outcome: A cut list, review checkpoints, and a target export specification for a manual timeline edit.
en.example: Use the OpenCut README to distinguish Classic from rewrite plans. From my timecoded customer interview transcript, draft a 45-second cut list with source ranges, continuity checks and a review question for each cut. Mark uncertain timestamps and leave media editing for my approval.

zh.title: 为 OpenCut 整理带时间码的剪辑清单
zh.description: 把逐字稿或素材目录变成可交接的时间线方案，记录片段起止点和导出前需要核对的细节。
zh.inputLabel: 哪段录制需要剪辑？
zh.inputHint: 提供素材名、时间码、目标时长及面向的观众。
zh.outcome: 一份剪辑清单、审阅检查点和手动时间线剪辑的目标导出规格。
zh.example: 参考 OpenCut README 区分 Classic 和新版计划。根据我带时间码的访谈逐字稿，拟一份 45 秒剪辑清单，列出素材区间、衔接检查点和每处剪辑要确认的问题。标出不确定的时间码，先交我审阅。

en.title: Plan a product demo from an existing screen recording
en.description: Use OpenMontage’s staged production workflow to plan a short demo around the actions your viewer needs to see. Keep the footage, caption plan and final checks traceable.
en.inputLabel: What should a viewer learn from the demo?
en.inputHint: List the source recording, essential actions, duration, audience and output aspect ratio.
en.outcome: An edit brief with timestamped scene choices, caption notes and a pre-delivery checklist.
en.example: Review the OpenMontage repository and help plan a 45-second demo from my existing screen recording. Keep onboarding, search and the export confirmation visible. Propose a timestamped edit, flag caption overlaps and list checks for the 9:16 export. Ask before sending footage to an external service.

zh.title: 把现有录屏整理成产品演示剪辑方案
zh.description: 参考 OpenMontage 的分阶段做法，围绕观众必须看到的操作安排短片。把每段素材、字幕位置和成片检查项对应起来。
zh.inputLabel: 希望观众看完演示后能做什么？
zh.inputHint: 写下源录屏、关键操作、目标时长、受众与输出比例。
zh.outcome: 一份含时间码的剪辑任务书、字幕说明和交付前检查清单。
zh.example: 阅读 OpenMontage 仓库，根据我的现有录屏规划 45 秒产品演示。保留首次设置、搜索和导出确认三个动作。给出带时间码的剪辑方案，指出字幕可能遮挡的位置，并列出竖版导出的检查项。上传录屏到外部服务前先问我。

en.title: Write a design-system brief for an interactive prototype
en.description: Bring one user flow and the visual rules it should follow. Use OpenDesign’s project workflow to separate reusable brand rules from screen behavior and prepare files a reviewer can inspect.
en.inputLabel: Which user flow should the prototype cover?
en.inputHint: List the screens, failure states, accessibility needs, and the approved design rules.
en.outcome: A DESIGN.md outline, screen checklist, and an editable-artifact handoff plan.
en.example: Review how OpenDesign combines DESIGN.md and prototype templates. Plan a three-screen onboarding prototype with a failed verification state. Separate reusable visual rules from per-screen behavior, identify assets I need to supply, and list what engineering must verify before implementation.

zh.title: 为交互原型写一份带设计规则的任务书
zh.description: 先选一个用户流程和已确认的视觉规则。参考 OpenDesign 的做法，将可复用的规则与每个页面的行为分开写，并明确要交给审阅人的文件。
zh.inputLabel: 原型需要覆盖哪个用户流程？
zh.inputHint: 列出页面、失败状态、无障碍要求和已经确定的视觉规范。
zh.outcome: 一份 DESIGN.md 提纲、页面状态清单和可编辑产物的交接方案。
zh.example: 参考 OpenDesign 如何组合 DESIGN.md 和原型模板，为三屏新手引导写任务书，包含验证失败状态。将可复用的视觉规则与单屏行为分开，标出需要我提供的素材，并列出交给开发前的检查项。

en.title: Design a narrow memory handoff for a coding project
en.description: Choose a recurring context gap and use Claude-Mem’s search, timeline and selected records as a model for a lightweight handoff.
en.inputLabel: Which decision keeps getting lost between sessions?
en.inputHint: Name the project, typical interruption and the source records that may be retained.
en.outcome: A decision-log schema, retrieval checks and an explicit retention and review boundary.
en.example: Read the Claude-Mem architecture and search docs. For our checkout bug investigation, design a handoff with observation IDs, one timeline window and a branch/test reference. Define what must stay out of memory and how to verify a recalled claim before editing code.

zh.title: 为编程项目设计一份可控的记忆交接
zh.description: 选一个反复丢失的上下文，参考 Claude-Mem 的搜索、时间线和按编号读取机制，设计一份轻量交接。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个决定总在换会话时丢失？
zh.inputHint: 提供项目名称、常见的中断点和允许保留的来源记录。
zh.outcome: 一份决策记录格式、检索检查点，以及明确的数据保留与复核范围。
zh.example: 阅读 Claude-Mem 的架构和搜索文档。为结账模块的错误调查设计一份交接，写明观察编号、相关时间范围和分支或测试引用。列出不能进入记忆的内容，以及改代码前如何核对找回的说法。

en.title: Test whether compressed logs preserve the right diagnosis
en.description: Use Caveman Engine’s compression and recovery pattern to compare the same incident evidence in raw and compact form.
en.inputLabel: Which log or tool output should be tested?
en.inputHint: Describe a sanitized sample, the expected diagnosis and the exact lines required to verify it.
en.outcome: A comparison plan with a raw baseline, recovery checks and separate local and provider measurement fields.
en.example: Read the Caveman Engine docs. Design a comparison on a sanitized CI log with a network failure and a secondary error. Specify how to recover the original lines, which diagnosis must stay stable and how to record inferred tokens separately from provider usage.

zh.title: 验证压缩日志能否支持同一个故障判断
zh.description: 参考 Caveman Engine 的压缩与恢复机制，比较同一份故障证据的原始版和短视图。
zh.inputLabel: 要测试哪份日志或工具输出？
zh.inputHint: 描述脱敏样本、预期故障判断和用于复核的具体日志行。
zh.outcome: 一份对比方案，包含原始基线、恢复检查，以及分开记录的本地估算和服务商用量。
zh.example: 阅读 Caveman Engine 文档，为一份脱敏 CI 日志设计对比测试，其中有网络故障和一个次生错误。写明如何恢复原始行、两轮应得到的故障判断，以及如何分别记录估算 Token 和服务商用量。

en.title: Make a noisy test log searchable
en.description: Design a local evidence workflow that returns the failing test and related lines while keeping the full log available.
en.inputLabel: Which command produces too much output?
en.inputHint: Describe the command, log size and the errors you need to preserve.
en.outcome: A log-indexing plan with retrieval examples and a check that the excerpts preserve the failure evidence.
en.example: Study Context Mode’s local indexing pattern. Given a test log, propose how to return failures by test name and retrieve supporting stack lines. Compare the evidence with the raw log and show how I can measure context usage.

zh.title: 把长测试日志变成可按需检索的证据
zh.description: 设计本地取证流程，让模型只收到失败用例和相关行，同时保留可以复核的完整日志。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个命令产生的输出太长？
zh.inputHint: 写明命令、日志规模和必须保留的错误信息。
zh.outcome: 一份日志索引与检索方案，附可检查片段是否保留故障证据的用例。
zh.example: 参考 Context Mode 的本地索引方式，设计从长测试日志按用例名返回失败信息和相关调用栈的方案。用原始日志复核取回的证据，并说明如何测量上下文占用。

en.title: Turn a debug update into one next action
en.description: Bring a long status message and identify the command and evidence that must survive the rewrite.
en.inputLabel: Which debugging update is hard to act on?
en.inputHint: Include the current blocker, failing check and any paths or error codes.
en.outcome: An action-first update with the exact check, state, and remaining decision.

zh.title: 把调试进度改成一条可执行的下一步
zh.description: 提供一段难以扫读的调试进度，先标出改写必须保留的命令和证据。
zh.inputLabel: 哪段调试进度需要改写？
zh.inputHint: 写明当前阻塞、失败检查及相关路径或错误码。
zh.outcome: 一段行动优先的进度说明，保留精确命令、状态和待决定事项。

en.title: Review one repository’s engineering Skill setup
en.description: Use the current repository conventions to propose tracker, label and domain-document configuration for review.
en.inputLabel: Which repository needs shared Skill configuration?
en.inputHint: Include the current tracker, existing labels and glossary or ADR locations.
en.outcome: A configuration draft with proposed file paths and any remote changes separated for approval.

zh.title: 为仓库审阅一份工程 Skill 配置草案
zh.description: 根据已有约定提出跟踪器、分诊标签和领域文档配置，再逐项审阅。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个仓库需要共享 Skill 配置？
zh.inputHint: 提供现有跟踪器、标签、术语表或 ADR 位置。
zh.outcome: 一份配置草案，列清拟改的文件以及需要单独确认的远端改动。

en.title: Decide what should happen to one issue
en.description: Gather evidence for the issue before assigning a category or state. Keep the proposed tracker update separate from the review.
en.inputLabel: Which issue or PR needs triage?
en.inputHint: Provide its URL, repository conventions and any attempted reproduction.
en.outcome: A reasoned state recommendation with an agent brief or one targeted follow-up question.

zh.title: 为一个 Issue 取证并建议分诊状态
zh.description: 先检查 Issue 证据，再建议类别和状态。分诊结论与跟踪器的实际更新分别确认。
zh.inputLabel: 哪条 Issue 或 PR 需要分诊？
zh.inputHint: 提供链接、仓库约定和已经做过的复现。
zh.outcome: 一份带依据的状态建议，以及 Agent 任务书或一个有针对性的追问。

en.title: Prepare a task that survives a session reset
en.description: Choose a project that needs more than one session. Define what belongs in the phase plan, source notes, and verification log so another agent can identify the next action.
en.inputLabel: Which long-running task needs a handoff?
en.inputHint: List the project, key phases, current blocker, and approval boundaries.
en.outcome: A three-file planning outline and a fresh-session recovery check.

zh.title: 为需要跨会话的任务准备交接文件
zh.description: 选一项无法在一个会话内完成的工作，分清阶段计划、来源记录和验证日志，确保接手的人能找到明确的下一步。
zh.inputLabel: 哪项长任务需要跨会话交接？
zh.inputHint: 说明项目、关键阶段、当前阻塞，以及哪些操作需要确认。
zh.outcome: 一份三文件规划提纲，以及验证新会话能否接手的检查步骤。

en.title: Check an authorized username across selected sites
en.description: Give the agent an exact username and a short list of approved sites. Have it record public candidate URLs and leave ownership decisions for review.
en.inputLabel: Which username and sites are approved?
en.inputHint: Provide a handle you manage or have permission to check, the site list, and an output folder.
en.outcome: A candidate URL table with site coverage and a verification column.
en.example: Check whether Sherlock is installed. Prepare a search for my approved username on the sites I list, then show me the planned command before making network requests. After I approve the command, run it, save candidate URLs in the approved folder, and flag each row for manual verification.

zh.title: 在指定网站核验获准的用户名
zh.description: 提供准确的用户名和允许查询的网站，让 Agent 记录公开候选链接，并把账号归属交给负责人复核。
zh.inputLabel: 允许查询哪个用户名和哪些网站？
zh.inputHint: 填写自己管理或获准核验的用户名、网站列表和输出目录。
zh.outcome: 一张候选链接表，附查询范围和人工核验状态。
zh.example: 先检查 Sherlock 是否已安装。按我提供的用户名和网站范围准备查询命令，联网前先给我核对。我确认命令后再执行，将候选链接保存到获准的目录，每条结果标记为待人工核验。

en.title: Prepare a bounded OpenClaw run
en.description: Choose headless execution or a Gateway session, then make the input, access and expected output explicit.
en.inputLabel: What should the run produce?
en.inputHint: Provide a workspace, allowed input files and one artifact to verify.
en.outcome: A reviewed CLI run plan and an artifact with explicit checks.
en.example: Read the official OpenClaw agent CLI docs. Prepare a headless task that summarizes my approved test log. Show the command and workspace before execution. After approval, run it only if the runtime is configured and verify the output against the log.

zh.title: 准备一次范围明确的 OpenClaw 执行
zh.description: 根据任务选择无界面命令或 Gateway 会话，先明确输入、权限和预期结果。
zh.inputLabel: 这次运行应交付什么？
zh.inputHint: 提供工作区、获准输入和一份需要核验的产物。
zh.outcome: 一份可复核的运行方案，以及带检查依据的输出。
zh.example: 阅读 OpenClaw 的官方 Agent CLI 文档。为获准使用的测试日志准备一次无界面摘要任务，先列出命令与工作区。我确认后，只有运行环境已配置才执行，并回到原日志核对输出。

en.title: Preview ECC changes for Codex
en.description: Plan the package version, host and write scope before an agent touches configuration.
en.inputLabel: Which workspace will receive ECC?
en.inputHint: Give the workspace path, current host version and allowed setup scope.
en.outcome: A dry-run report and a reviewable list of proposed writes.
en.example: Read the official ECC install instructions. Check Node and Codex, then show me the guided Codex dry-run command. After approval, run only the preview and report its destination and proposed writes.

zh.title: 预演 ECC 对 Codex 的配置改动
zh.description: 在 Agent 写入前先限定包版本、目标宿主与允许配置的范围。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个工作区要配置 ECC？
zh.inputHint: 提供工作区路径、宿主版本和允许的安装范围。
zh.outcome: 一份预演报告，列出安装位置和计划写入。
zh.example: 读取 ECC 官方安装文档，检查 Node 和 Codex，并给我看引导安装的预演命令。我确认后只运行预演，报告目标位置和计划写入。

en.title: Inspect a local dataset before analysis
en.description: Record the allowed input and check aggregate structure and missingness before choosing an analysis.
en.inputLabel: Which dataset should be profiled?
en.inputHint: Provide the approved folder, filename, and the decision this inspection will inform.
en.outcome: A redacted aggregate report with explicit coverage and data-quality checks.

zh.title: 分析前检查本地数据
zh.description: 根据获准的输入范围，先核对数据结构和缺失情况，再选择分析方法。
zh.inputLabel: 要检查哪份数据？
zh.inputHint: 提供获准访问的目录、文件名和本次需要支持的决定。
zh.outcome: 一份带覆盖范围和数据质量检查项的去敏汇总。

en.title: Inspect an authorized binary with REA
en.description: Identify the local artifact and ask a precise question before choosing a static inspection.
en.inputLabel: Which binary can the agent inspect?
en.inputHint: Provide an approved file and the expected build target.
en.outcome: A layout summary with the artifact reference and evidence for each claim.
en.example: Review REA’s official binary diagnostics. Check whether the REA CLI or MCP is available and show the planned read-only layout inspection for my approved binary. After I approve the command, run the inspection without launching the binary and save the evidence alongside the summary.

zh.title: 用 REA 检查获准分析的二进制
zh.description: 明确本地制品和要核验的问题，再选静态检查方式。
zh.inputLabel: Agent 可以检查哪个文件？
zh.inputHint: 提供获准分析的路径和预期构建目标。
zh.outcome: 一份带制品引用和对应证据的布局摘要。
zh.example: 阅读 REA 官方二进制诊断文档，先检查 CLI 或 MCP 是否可用，再展示针对我获准分析的二进制的只读布局检查方案。我确认后执行检查，无需启动被检查的程序，并把证据与摘要一起保存。

en.title: Plan and verify a bounded code change
en.description: Start with an approved design and a repository whose tests the agent can run.
en.inputLabel: Which approved change should the agent implement?
en.inputHint: Provide the repository, acceptance criteria and relevant test commands.
en.outcome: A reviewable plan and patch with fresh test evidence.
en.example: Check that Superpowers is available in this coding agent. Turn my approved change into file-level steps and show me the plan. After I approve implementation, add the regression test, record the failing and passing runs, and share the resulting diff and fresh verification output.

zh.title: 用 Superpowers 计划并核验一次改动
zh.description: 从已批准的设计和 Agent 能运行测试的仓库开始。
zh.inputLabel: 这次获准实施哪项改动？
zh.inputHint: 提供仓库、验收条件和相关测试命令。
zh.outcome: 一份可复核的计划、补丁和本次运行取得的测试证据。
zh.example: 先检查当前编程 Agent 是否已安装 Superpowers。把我批准的改动拆成文件级步骤并展示计划。我确认实施后，先添加回归测试，记录失败和通过两次结果，再交付差异和最新验证输出。

en.title: Produce a report-only QA handoff
en.description: Specify the surface, reproduction scope, and evidence to collect before anyone changes the product.
en.inputLabel: Which approved behavior needs checking?
en.inputHint: Provide a local or staging target, synthetic fixture, expected behavior, and report location.
en.outcome: A QA report with replayable steps, evidence, and explicit gaps.

zh.title: 生成可交接的 QA 报告
zh.description: 在修改产品前，明确测试对象、复现范围和需要保留的证据。
zh.inputLabel: 哪个获准的行为需要核验？
zh.inputHint: 提供本地或测试环境、合成数据、预期行为和输出目录。
zh.outcome: 一份含可复现步骤、证据和覆盖缺口的 QA 报告。

en.title: Capture browser evidence for a failed interaction
en.description: Give the agent a test page and a single interaction to inspect in an isolated Chrome profile.
en.inputLabel: What interaction should the browser reproduce?
en.inputHint: Provide an approved URL, synthetic data, expected behavior, and the evidence needed.
en.outcome: A sanitized record of the action, visible state, and relevant runtime evidence.

zh.title: 收集失败交互的浏览器证据
zh.description: 提供测试页面和一个明确交互，让 Agent 在隔离的 Chrome 配置中检查。
zh.inputLabel: 需要复现哪个交互？
zh.inputHint: 填写获准的测试地址、测试数据、预期行为和所需证据。
zh.outcome: 一份脱敏的操作记录，包含界面状态和相关运行时证据。

en.title: Reproduce a local UI failure with Playwright
en.description: Give the agent an approved local page and one visible expected result. Save a script and evidence another developer can rerun.
en.inputLabel: Which local interaction should be tested?
en.inputHint: Provide the local route, expected behavior and synthetic inputs.
en.outcome: A repeatable script and a short report with actual results.

zh.title: 用 Playwright 复现一处本地界面故障
zh.description: 给出获准的本地页面和一个可观察的预期结果，保留其他开发者能复跑的脚本与证据。
zh.inputLabel: 要检查哪个本地交互？
zh.inputHint: 给出本地路由、预期行为与模拟输入。
zh.outcome: 可重跑的脚本与包含实际结果的简报。

en.title: Redesign a landing page against a visual brief
en.description: Use a real brief, existing component constraints and approved imagery. Review the result in a browser at representative widths.
en.inputLabel: Which page and sections should change?
en.inputHint: Provide the route, target audience, approved assets and preserved sections.
en.outcome: A working page and a viewport review with evidence.

zh.title: 根据视觉简报调整落地页
zh.description: 让 Agent 使用真实简报、现有组件和获准素材，并在代表性屏幕宽度下检查。
zh.inputLabel: 要改哪个页面和区域？
zh.inputHint: 提供路由、目标受众、已批准素材与须保留的区域。
zh.outcome: 可运行的页面和带依据的多宽度复核记录。

en.title: Compare a terse reply with its source
en.description: Check that shortening the visible response preserves the exact error and verification status.
en.inputLabel: Which technical reply should be shortened?
en.inputHint: Provide a saved log, diff or handoff with facts that must stay.
en.outcome: A shorter reply with the same technical evidence.

zh.title: 核对短回复是否保留了技术依据
zh.description: 让 Agent 精简可见回复，并核对错误原文和实际验证状态。
zh.inputLabel: 哪份技术回复需要缩短？
zh.inputHint: 提供已有日志、差异或交接材料，指出必须保留的事实。
zh.outcome: 一份更短但保留相同技术证据的回复。

en.title: Prepare a rehearsable live deck
en.description: Translate the talk outline into slides, reveals and presenter notes. Verify the local audience and presenter views.
en.inputLabel: What is the presentation outline?
en.inputHint: Provide approved assets, slides, reveals, and any branching paths.
en.outcome: A locally served HTML deck and a rehearsal checklist.

zh.title: 准备可排练的现场幻灯片
zh.description: 把提纲拆成幻灯片、逐步展示项和演讲者备注，复核本地观众与演讲者视图。
zh.inputLabel: 本次演示有哪些内容？
zh.inputHint: 给出提纲、获准素材、揭示顺序及分支。
zh.outcome: 可在本地打开的 HTML 演示和一份排练清单。

en.title: Prioritize an SEO repair queue
en.description: Give the agent approved URLs and search artifacts, then ask for evidence and a retest for each finding.
en.inputLabel: Which URLs need checking?
en.inputHint: Provide sample routes, target index state and any authorized search export.
en.outcome: A ranked audit report with URL-level evidence.

zh.title: 排列 SEO 修复清单
zh.description: 给 Agent 获准 URL 与搜索资料，为每个问题保留依据和复验方式。
zh.inputLabel: 要检查哪些 URL？
zh.inputHint: 提供样本路由、预期索引状态和获准的搜索数据。
zh.outcome: 包含 URL 级证据的优先级报告。

en.title: Draft a landing-page message
en.description: Use audience evidence and a real offer to draft copy with a clear next action.
en.inputLabel: Which page and action are you drafting for?
en.inputHint: Provide approved claims, reader objections and a desired CTA.
en.outcome: A page draft with claims tied to evidence.

zh.title: 起草一份落地页卖点文案
zh.description: 根据受众、真实提案和可引用证据写出有明确行动的文案。
zh.inputLabel: 要为哪个页面和行动起草？
zh.inputHint: 提供已核实卖点、受众疑虑与目标按钮。
zh.outcome: 一份可以逐条核对承诺依据的页面草稿。

en.title: Plan a small editorial roadmap
en.description: Combine audience questions and existing coverage to rank a feasible set of topics.
en.inputLabel: What audience and timeframe are in scope?
en.inputHint: Provide questions, inventory, output goals and team capacity.
en.outcome: A prioritized content queue with first-batch briefs.

zh.title: 制定一份可执行的编辑路线图
zh.description: 把受众问题和当前内容覆盖结合起来，给选题排出能执行的先后顺序。
zh.inputLabel: 面向哪个受众、计划多久？
zh.inputHint: 提供受众问题、内容清单、目标和团队产能。
zh.outcome: 一份有优先级的选题队列和首批简报。

en.title: Review motion before merging
en.description: Give the agent changed files and a motion scenario, then ask for evidence-backed findings.
en.inputLabel: Which interaction should be reviewed?
en.inputHint: Provide files, reproduction steps, browser and accessibility states.
en.outcome: A prioritized critique with reproduction and follow-up checks.

zh.title: 合并前复核一次界面动效
zh.description: 向 Agent 提供变更文件与动效场景，要求按证据输出审查发现。
zh.inputLabel: 要复核哪个交互？
zh.inputHint: 给出文件、复现步骤、浏览器与可访问性状态。
zh.outcome: 一份带复现方法和复验条件的优先级审查。

en.title: Build and verify a web gesture
en.description: Provide the component and expected states, then exercise the gesture and an accessible alternative.
en.inputLabel: Which gesture needs implementation?
en.inputHint: Give the component, target inputs, expected release behavior and access requirements.
en.outcome: An implemented interaction with explicit state checks.

zh.title: 实现并核对网页手势
zh.description: 提供目标组件与预期状态，让 Agent 验证手势和可访问的替代路径。
zh.inputLabel: 要实现哪个交互手势？
zh.inputHint: 给出组件、输入方式、松手后的表现和可访问性要求。
zh.outcome: 可运行的交互及明确的状态检查记录。

en.title: Build a source-checked web extraction
en.description: Provide either a research question or approved URLs. Choose the MCP operation that fits, then ask for structured output with evidence from the original pages.
en.inputLabel: Which pages or question should the Agent use?
en.inputHint: Supply approved URLs or a narrow query, desired fields, and a page limit.
en.outcome: A structured table or JSON file with source URLs and explicit missing fields.
en.example: Check which Firecrawl MCP tools are available. Read the approved product pages and extract the requested fields as JSON. Verify each value against the page, preserve its URL, and leave ambiguous values for review.

zh.title: 用 Firecrawl 提取可回查的网页数据
zh.description: 提供一个查询问题或获准网址。按输入选择 MCP 工具，并让结果保留可以返回原网页核对的依据。
zh.inputLabel: 需要查询哪些页面或问题？
zh.inputHint: 填写获准网址或明确的问题、所需字段和页数上限。
zh.outcome: 一份包含来源网址与缺失标记的表格或 JSON 文件。
zh.example: 先核对当前会话可调用的 Firecrawl MCP 工具。读取我批准的产品页面，按指定字段输出 JSON。将值与页面原文核对，保留网址，歧义项留待复核。

en.title: Check a Supabase project without making changes
en.description: Identify the project and question before opening the connection. Start with metadata and approve any query only if it adds evidence the task needs.
en.inputLabel: Which project and schema should the Agent inspect?
en.inputHint: Provide the approved project reference, relevant tables or schemas, and permitted outputs.
en.outcome: A read-only inspection note with the project scope, tool evidence, and open questions.
en.example: Use the approved read-only Supabase MCP connection for my development project. Confirm its project reference, inspect the named schema, and compare the tables with the repository. Show me any proposed SQL and wait for my approval before running it. Report only the approved metadata or aggregate results.

zh.title: 核对 Supabase 项目而不修改数据库
zh.description: 先明确项目和问题，从结构元数据开始；需要进一步取证时，再审查拟执行的只读查询。
zh.inputLabel: 要核对哪个项目与 schema？
zh.inputHint: 提供已批准的项目引用、涉及的表或 schema，以及允许交付的结果范围。
zh.outcome: 一份只读核验记录，注明项目范围、工具结果和待确认事项。
zh.example: 使用我获准的开发项目 Supabase 只读 MCP。先核对项目引用，检查指定 schema，并把表结构与仓库对照。先给我看拟执行的 SQL，经我确认后再运行。只报告获准的元数据或汇总结果。

en.title: Compare One Autoresearch Candidate With Its Baseline
en.description: Define a single training change and record the setup before asking the agent to run the experiment.
en.inputLabel: Which training change should the agent test?
en.inputHint: Give the repository path, prepared GPU environment, baseline commit, one hypothesis, and the approved trial limit.
en.outcome: A run log, a results.tsv entry, and a baseline comparison with a keep, discard, or crash decision.
en.example: Read the official Autoresearch program.md. Check my GPU, prepared data, and dedicated branch. Show the baseline and one train.py candidate plan. After I approve the commands, run only the agreed trials and compare val_bpb, peak memory, and status in the local ledger.

zh.title: 对照基线验证一次 Autoresearch 改动
zh.description: 先定义一项训练改动并记录环境，再授权 Agent 开始实验。
zh.inputLabel: 本轮要验证哪个训练假设？
zh.inputHint: 提供仓库位置、已准备的 GPU 环境、基线提交、单项假设和批准的运行轮数。
zh.outcome: 运行日志、results.tsv 记录，以及一份标明保留、放弃或崩溃的基线对照。
zh.example: 先阅读 Autoresearch 官方 program.md，核对 GPU、准备好的数据与独立分支。给我看基线及一项 train.py 改动的运行计划。我批准命令后，只运行约定的实验，并在本地台账中对照 val_bpb、显存峰值和状态。

en.title: Select One Scientific Agent Skill for Your Research Task
en.description: Define the research stage, available materials, and one artifact before selecting a workflow.
en.inputLabel: What research output needs to be produced?
en.inputHint: Provide the study stage, approved inputs, preferred host, expected output, and any restrictions on network or credentials.
en.outcome: A Skill selection with source, license, prerequisites, and a bounded workflow for a reviewer to approve.
en.example: Read the official Scientific Agent Skills catalog. For my study-design brief, pick one suitable Skill and check its SKILL.md for license, dependencies, and output. Propose a local-only workflow and get my approval before installing or running anything.

zh.title: 为一项科研任务选择合适的 Skill
zh.description: 在选工作流之前，先说明研究阶段、手头材料和一项待交付的产物。
zh.inputLabel: 你需要产出哪种科研材料？
zh.inputHint: 提供研究阶段、获准输入、使用的宿主、预期交付，以及联网或凭据限制。
zh.outcome: 一份标明来源、许可、执行前提和任务范围的 Skill 选用方案。
zh.example: 先阅读 Scientific Agent Skills 官方目录，为我的实验设计简报选择一项适用 Skill。检查 SKILL.md 的许可、依赖与交付要求，提出只在本地运行的方案，并在我批准前不安装或执行。
